strings.note: Title printed at the top of the till tape the register prints when the bar closes for good (the game over): the whole run's figures on one receipt. "Z report" is a till's end-of-day total; keep the Z. Display face 16 px, centred on a 392 px tape, one line, about 20 characters.

Small line under FINAL Z REPORT on the game over's tape. {when} = the last night's week and weekday, already translated (calendar.week_night, e.g. "WEEK 2 · FRIDAY"); {seed} = the run's code, ASCII letters and digits (e.g. MC-4F2A91), never translated. Body face 8 px, centred on 392 px, one line.

Row label on the game over's tape beside the biggest figure on it: how many nights the bar stayed open before it closed. Body face 16 px at the left of a 392 px row, a large number at the right, about 20 characters.
Block heading on the game over's tape over the bar's best rung and best night. Heavy face 16 px, printed letter-spaced (a space after every letter), so about 14 characters.
Block heading on the game over's tape over the run's money: took in, tips, paid out, rent. Heavy face 16 px, letter-spaced, about 14 characters.
Block heading on the game over's tape over guests served, walked out, recipes perfected and the hostess's jobs. Heavy face 16 px, letter-spaced, about 14 characters.
Row label on the game over's tape: the night of the run that took in the most money; {n} = that night's number. The money figure sits at its right. Body face 16 px, about 24 characters.
Row label on the game over's tape: customers who got a drink over the whole run; a number at its right. Body face 16 px, about 20 characters.
Row label on the game over's tape: customers who left without their drink over the whole run; a red number at its right. Body face 16 px, about 20 characters.
Row label on the game over's tape: recipes in the bar's book made perfectly at least once; gameover.z.of ("5 OF 12") sits at its right. Body face 16 px, about 20 characters.

Row label on the game over's tape: the hostess's jobs done over the run; gameover.z.of sits at its right. {who} = her first name in capitals, from the cast file (never write a name here). Body face 16 px, about 20 characters.
Right-hand figure of a row on the game over's tape: {n} done out of {total} (recipes perfected, jobs done). Both are whole numbers. Body face 16 px, right-aligned, about 12 characters.
Heading of the landlord's notice beside the game over's tape: the paper that shuts the bar. Display face 16 px, red, centred in 400 px, one line, about 20 characters.

strings.text: One night in a row closed under $0. By order of the landlord these premises are shut.
strings.note: The notice's text, sentence case, formal like a legal notice. {n} = how many nights in a row the bar closed in debt (the run ends at that count). English #one spells the number; write {n} in every form of your language, #one included (the table check requires it). Body face 16 px, 380 px wide, wraps; the paper grows with it and a red stamp lands across its middle.

strings.text: {n} nights in a row closed under $0. By order of the landlord these premises are shut.
strings.note: As gameover.notice.body#one.
Row label on the landlord's notice for one of the red nights that shut the bar; {n} = the night's number. The till it closed at sits at its right in red. Body face 16 px, about 12 characters.

Small line under each red night on the landlord's notice: what that night took in and paid out. {in} and {out} are whole numbers (digits only; the $ is written here). Lower case, body face 8 px, 380 px, one line.
Signature at the foot of the landlord's notice, right-aligned. Body face 8 px, about 20 characters.

Rubber stamp struck across the landlord's notice when the bar closes for good - the landlord's word for putting the bar out (the author, 2026-09-28: not CLOSED, which the night's neon sign already says). Heavy face 24 px inside a 256x54 stamp (about 226 px of room), one line, about 10 characters.

strings.text: The save closed with the bar. NEW RUN waits at the front door.
strings.note: Small line under the MAIN MENU key on the game over: the saved game was deleted with the bar, and a new run starts from the main menu. NEW RUN must match chrome.pause.new_run (the main menu's key). Body face 8 px, 440 px, wraps to two lines at most.
